implementation: Original generic per-lane verification transaction and segmented compute view
source_paths: mlx_lm/models/cache.py:KVCache and RotatingKVCache exact state and update semantics
reuse: Calls existing mlx2 native cache classes and generic attention seam. No legacy APC/server import or model-name condition. New module is original project code; no upstream class copied into it.

interface.verify: owner.begin(lengths) returns transaction with prepared transaction.caches layer views; model(inputs, cache=transaction.caches)
interface.commit: transaction.commit(accepted_lengths) publishes exact verified input prefix count for each lane; DFlash anchor+proposals uses 1+accepted_proposals
interface.abort: transaction.abort() or context-manager exception restores pre-round cache state including evicted ring tokens
interface.membership: owner.filter(indices), owner.extend(rows), owner.extract(index) only outside active transactions; clone_kv_row(caches) creates independent idle checkpoint
interface.memory: owner.nbytes includes authoritative arrays, full pre-round snapshot arrays and saved append arrays. transaction.snapshot_nbytes and retained_nbytes are exposed. Snapshot/replay may transiently require additional copy memory; native MLX allocator qualification is mandatory before serving admission is considered calibrated.
interface.attention: Projection/trunk remain batch-shaped; each row's native cache mask and SDPA are evaluated independently. No merged historical KV slab, new fused attention kernel, or shared rotating-cache rewind.
interface.unsupported: Only exact plain KVCache and RotatingKVCache types, B1 authoritative rows, equal layer topology across lanes. Quantized/ring subclasses and pre-existing speculation ownership rejected. Arbitrary external in-place array writes violate exclusive-owner contract and are not detectable solely through pointer/offset stamps.

validation.stage: CPU/NumPy actual production class bodies only; no model load or GPU
validation.tests: 13 tests pass, including 80 randomized multi-round cases across B1..B4 (200 lane-rounds), divergent accepted lengths, wrap/eviction restoration, global+ring layers, partial-forward cancellation, extraction/filter/extend, stale transaction and geometry guards, shared mask reuse, and closed-transaction reference release
validation.oracle: Independent full-history sliding/global attention, standalone native cache accepted-prefix replay, and offset-only rewind counterfactual that fails after eviction
validation.native_gaps: Actual MLX snapshot copy semantics, array-offset RoPE, native SDPA numerics/performance and memory admission remain unqualified; Muse owner may run explicit-CPU tiny target tests before any separately authorized GPU test

qualification: implemented and CPU-oracle verified in isolated snapshot only; no production route enabled
